_generated: GENERATED, not hand-written: by reading the sibling repos chopshop-flux (chopshop_flux/config.py, chopshop_flux/models.py, docs/API.md) and chopshop-plot (chopshop_plot/config.py, chopshop_plot/spec.py, chopshop_plot/server.py, chopshop_plot/metrics.py, docs/contract.md) and transcribing the constants from them. The studio's test container does NOT mount the siblings, so this file is the pin: re-read the siblings and regenerate this fixture when either service changes, then fix whichever conf has drifted. Regenerate with the same reader logic by hand -- the point is that the numbers here came from the services, not from the conf they are used to check.
_optional_live_check: Set CHOPSHOP_SIBLING_ROOT to the directory holding the sibling repos (default: the studio's parent directory) and the drift test ALSO re-reads chopshop-flux/chopshop_flux/models.py and chopshop-plot/chopshop_plot/server.py to confirm this fixture is still current. It never depends on that read: without the siblings the test runs against this file alone.
